post.text:
Found it: the sign-in button's text and background were hard-coded dark, so in dark mode it blends into the page. It now uses the theme's colors, and I measured the contrast on all four pages that use it:

| Page | Button | Light | Dark (before) | Dark (after) | Tests |
|:--|:--|--:|--:|--:|:-:|
| Sign in | Sign in | 7.8 | 1.1 | 7.2 | ✅ |
| Sign up | Create account | 7.8 | 1.1 | 7.2 | ✅ |
| Reset password | Send code | 7.8 | 1.3 | 7.2 | ✅ |
| Settings | Sign out | 6.9 | 1.2 | 6.5 | ✅ |

Anything above 4.5 is readable, and all four pass now. The sign-in page before and after:
Good catch: the link was the old purple at 3.1, under 4.5. It now uses the theme's link color at 7.4. The sign-in page now:
